explanation: Sharpless asymmetric epoxidation: t-BuOOH delivers oxygen to the C=C of an allylic alcohol through a titanium–tartrate complex. The chiral tartrate picks one face, so one enantiomer of the epoxy alcohol forms; isolated alkenes are left alone. (Carey 17.9: trans-2-hexen-1-ol with diethyl (2R,3R)-tartrate → (2S,3S)-2,3-epoxy-1-hexanol, 78%, 98% ee.)
tip: Allylic alcohol + Sharpless = one enantiomer. Any other alkene + Sharpless = nothing.
